description:
Brand Introduction

Welcome to L'Amie de la santé, your trusted partner in health and wellness.  We are dedicated in offering high-quality vitamins, supplements, and wellness products that support the health and well-being of our customers.  Our products are carefully selected from reputable brands to ensure maximum efficacy to our clients.  We aim to empower people to live healthier, more vibrant lives, and we believe in making wellness accessible to all.

Product Description

Our store features a wide range of health and wellness products, including:

  • Vitamins & Minerals: Essential supplements to support immune health, bone strength, energy, and more.
  • Herbal Supplements: Nature-based products that help with everything from stress management to digestive health.
  • Protein & Fitness Supplements: Designed to support muscle growth, recovery, and overall fitness goals.
  • Personal Care & Beauty: Skin, hair, and body care items made from natural and nourishing ingredients.

Each product is formulated with quality and potency in mind, ensuring that your customers get the most out of their wellness routines.

Unique Selling Points

  • Premium Quality Ingredients: We only source the best ingredients from trusted suppliers to ensure potency and effectiveness.
  • Sustainable & Ethical Sourcing: We are committed to sustainability, using eco-friendly packaging and ethically sourcing ingredients.
  • Expert Formulations: Our products are formulated by experienced nutritionists, scientists, and wellness experts.
  • Subscription Service: Customers can set up a subscription for recurring orders with discounted rates for long-term wellness.

Affiliate Program Details

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates will earn between 12.5-20% commission on each sale made through their unique referral link. Additionally, there are opportunities to earn performance-based bonuses as your sales grow.
  • Cookie Duration: We offer a 45 day cookie window, meaning affiliates will receive commissions on purchases made within this time frame after a customer clicks their referral link.
  • Easy Tracking: Our affiliate program uses a reliable platform [UpPromote] to track sales and provide affiliates with real-time reporting on clicks, conversions, and commissions.
  • Promotional Materials: Affiliates have access to a variety of promotional materials, including banners, and product images, to help them market the products effectively.
  • Support: Our affiliate support team is always available to assist with any questions or concerns you may have to ensure you are successful in your promotional efforts.

Payment Terms

  • Payment Schedule: Affiliates are paid on a monthly basis.
  • Payment Methods: We offer payments through etransfer or Bank Transfer.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: The minimum payout threshold is $10.00. If an affiliate’s earnings do not meet the minimum threshold by the end of the payment cycle, the balance will roll over to the next cycle.
  • Refund Policy: In the event that a customer requests a refund or returns an item, the affiliate’s commission for that sale will be reversed.

Additional Information

  • Exclusive Discounts: Affiliates and their customers will receive exclusive discounts on products when they sign up for the affiliate program.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: High-performing affiliates who reach specific sales targets can earn bonuses or additional perks.
  • Product Sampling: Affiliates may receive free product samples to help them promote the products more effectively.
  • Terms and Conditions: Affiliates must comply with our [terms and conditions], including not making false claims or violating advertising guidelines. Full details will be available upon signup.

Ready to start earning? Join our affiliate program today and start sharing the benefits of wellness with your audience!

Sign up now and begin earning commissions on every sale you refer.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to L'Amie de la santé! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@amiedelasante.ca.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@amiedelasante.ca for support.
